restaurant_name: พิชาคลินิกเวชกรรม-พญ.พิชญากร ศิริตัน
text:
Dr. Picha, the owner, does everything herself. She's a dermatologist with extensive experience. I've had Ulthera treatment twice and saw real results. There are no sales pressures here; you get a skin analysis with the doctor before every treatment. They don't push courses on you, it's very relaxed.
The only downside is that the vial of medication they dispense is a bit large.

restaurant_name: พิชาคลินิกเวชกรรม-พญ.พิชญากร ศิริตัน
text: I used to get treatment for acne and acne scars from this doctor when she was at a private clinic in a mall. Then, when she opened her own clinic, I went to her to treat my thyroid surgery scar. She didn't push any anti-itch medication that required oral medication along with injections. Back then, I was a student and didn't have much money, but she didn't force me to buy it. She didn't make me feel uncomfortable. The keloid injection cost was also reasonable; after three injections, the raised scar flattened completely with the skin. I'm not in Chiang Mai anymore, but I miss her. She's very skilled and her prices are affordable. I hope her clinic stays open for a long time, and if I have the chance, I'd like to go back for treatment again.

restaurant_name: พิชาคลินิกเวชกรรม-พญ.พิชญากร ศิริตัน
text: Based on my experience treating melasma at Picha Clinic with Dr. Pichayakorn for a year and spending over 50,000 baht, I can proudly say that I regret the time, money, and disappointment caused by exaggerated and misleading advertising.
author_name: จินตนา มหานิล
